tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.tagline: The versatile AI assistant for dialogue and content creation
tools.description: ChatGPT by OpenAI is the most widely used large language model, capable of generating text, answering questions, writing code, and assisting with a huge range of educational tasks. The Edu tier adds enterprise-grade security, custom GPTs for departments, and data analytics dashboards designed for institutions.
values: Generate discussion questions, quiz items, or rubric drafts in seconds
Free tier handles most faculty tasks — GPT-4o included
Integrates with Canvas via plugins for in-platform use

pricing.details: Free tier available. Plus $20/mo. Team $25/user/mo. ChatGPT Edu available for institutions with volume pricing.

keyFeatures: Custom GPTs for specific department needs
Canvas for collaborative writing and code
pros: Largest ecosystem of plugins and GPTs
Strong at creative writing and brainstorming
Edu tier has FERPA compliance options
Most students already familiar with it
cons: Free tier has usage limits during peak times
Privacy concerns with training data for free tier
bestFor: Creating course materials and lesson plans
strengths: Extremely versatile across writing, analysis, and coding
limitations: Free tier has usage caps during peak hours
Output quality varies — prompt skill matters significantly
tools.quickstart: Start with: 'You are a helpful teaching assistant for [your course]. Help me draft three discussion questions about [topic] that target Bloom's analysis level.'

tools.name: Claude
tools.tagline: A next-generation AI assistant built for thoughtful analysis
tools.description: Claude by Anthropic excels at nuanced, long-form tasks thanks to its industry-leading 200K token context window. It can analyze entire textbooks, research papers, or policy documents in a single conversation. Known for being more cautious and less likely to hallucinate than competitors, it is especially well-suited for academic environments where accuracy matters.
values: 200K context window — paste entire textbooks or research papers
Strongest at nuanced writing feedback and academic tone
Built with safety-first design, less likely to fabricate citations

pricing.details: Free tier with daily limits. Pro $20/mo with higher limits. Team $25/user/mo. Enterprise with SSO and admin controls.

keyFeatures: 200K token context window for long documents
Artifacts for code, documents, and visualizations
Less prone to hallucination than competitors
pros: Best-in-class for document analysis and research
cons: Free tier has stricter daily limits
bestFor: Research paper analysis and literature reviews
strengths: Best-in-class at handling long documents (entire syllabi, papers, reports)
More cautious about uncertain claims — flags when it's unsure
Excellent writing quality with academic register
limitations: Can be overly cautious, sometimes declining reasonable requests
Web search is newer and less refined
tools.quickstart: Upload your syllabus and ask: 'Review this syllabus for clarity, consistency, and alignment between stated objectives and assessments. Flag any gaps.'

tools.name: Gemini
tools.tagline: Google's most capable AI model, built to be multimodal
tools.description: Google Gemini is deeply integrated into the Google ecosystem, making it a natural fit for institutions already using Google Workspace. It can analyze images, generate text, search the web in real-time, and work directly inside Docs, Sheets, Slides, and Gmail. The Advanced plan includes Gemini in Google Workspace apps for seamless productivity.
values: Built into Google Docs, Sheets, Slides — works where you already work
Multimodal: analyze images, charts, and documents natively
Free tier is generous for individual use

pricing.details: Free tier available. Advanced through Google One at $19.99/mo. Education pricing available for institutions.

keyFeatures: Works in Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail
pros: Seamless if your institution uses Google Workspace
cons: Less consistent than ChatGPT for creative tasks
strengths: Strong at data analysis in Sheets
Multimodal — can analyze images and PDFs
limitations: Responses can be less nuanced than Claude for academic writing
Privacy concerns with institutional Google data
tools.quickstart: In Google Docs, type '@Gemini' and ask it to help draft a course description or summarize meeting notes.

tools.name: Perplexity AI
tools.tagline: The conversational answer engine with cited sources
tools.description: Perplexity AI combines the conversational interface of a chatbot with the citation rigor of academic search. Every answer includes inline citations linked to source material, making it ideal for research, fact-checking, and teaching students how to verify AI outputs. The Pro plan adds access to multiple models and file upload for document analysis.
values: Every answer includes source citations — model research integrity for students
Academic focus mode searches scholarly databases specifically
Great for quick lit review scoping and fact-checking

pricing.details: Free tier with limited Pro searches. Pro $20/mo with unlimited searches and access to multiple models.

keyFeatures: Real-time web search with source verification
pros: Best citation practices of any AI tool
Great for teaching research verification skills
Academic focus mode filters for scholarly sources
cons: Less creative than ChatGPT or Claude
Free tier limits Pro searches significantly
Not great for long-form content generation

tools.name: Grok
tools.tagline: Real-time AI with access to live data from X
tools.description: Grok by xAI is integrated into the X (formerly Twitter) platform, giving it access to real-time conversations and trending topics. It takes a more irreverent, conversational tone and is particularly useful for monitoring current events and public discourse around higher education topics.
values: Real-time access to current events and breaking news
Less filtered responses — useful for devil's advocate exercises
Available through X (Twitter) platform

pricing.details: Available through X Premium+ subscription at $16/mo. No free tier.

pros: Excellent for current events and trending topics
Real-time data access unique among LLMs
cons: Less polished than ChatGPT or Claude
bestFor: Monitoring higher ed discourse on social media

tools.name: Eduaide.Ai
tools.tagline: An AI-powered workspace to maximize teacher impact
tools.description: Eduaide.Ai provides over 100 generative AI tools specifically designed for educators. It can create lesson plans, assessments, rubrics, feedback comments, and differentiated materials in seconds. The platform is built by educators for educators and understands pedagogical frameworks like UDL, Bloom's Taxonomy, and Webb's Depth of Knowledge.
values: Over 100 education-specific generators — not a generic chatbot
Outputs aligned to standards (Common Core, state frameworks)
Creates differentiated versions for diverse learner needs automatically

pricing.details: Free plan with limited generations per day. Pro plan at $5.99/mo with unlimited access. School/district pricing available.

keyFeatures: Lesson plan creator with standards alignment
Content aligned to Bloom's Taxonomy and UDL
pros: Purpose-built for educators, not a generic LLM
cons: Less flexible than a general-purpose LLM
Smaller user community than major LLMs
bestFor: Quick feedback drafts on student work
strengths: Education-specific — understands pedagogy, not just content
limitations: Generated content still needs instructor review and personalization
Some outputs feel templated — works best as a starting point
tools.quickstart: Select 'Lesson Plan' generator, input your subject, grade level, and standard. Review the output and customize timing and activities to fit your class.

tools.name: Brisk Teaching
tools.tagline: Teach smarter, not harder — AI right in your browser
tools.description: Brisk Teaching is a Chrome extension that brings AI-powered tools directly into Google Docs, Slides, YouTube, and other web apps teachers already use. With one click, teachers can create curriculum materials, level text for different reading abilities, generate quizzes from content, and provide writing feedback — all without leaving their workflow.
values: Works inside Canvas, Google Docs, Schoology — no tab switching
One-click reading level adjustment for any text
Generates instant feedback comments on student work

pricing.details: Free for individual teachers with core features. Premium plans for schools and districts with advanced features and admin controls.

keyFeatures: Chrome extension works inside existing tools
One-click curriculum creation from any content
Text leveling for different reading abilities
AI writing feedback for student work
Works in Google Docs, Slides, YouTube
pros: Zero learning curve — works in tools you already use
bestFor: Teachers who live in Google Workspace

tools.name: Curipod
tools.tagline: Spark curiosity in your classroom with AI-powered lessons
tools.description: Curipod generates complete, standards-aligned interactive slide decks with embedded student activities like polls, word clouds, open-ended questions, and drawing prompts. Teachers enter a topic and grade level, and Curipod produces a ready-to-teach lesson in minutes. It also provides AI feedback on student responses.
values: Students interact in real-time — polls, drawings, word clouds
AI generates complete interactive lessons from a topic
Built-in reflection and check-for-understanding prompts

pricing.details: Free plan with limited slide generation. Premium at ~$90/year with unlimited lessons and features.

keyFeatures: Embedded polls, word clouds, and activities
pros: Very fast — topic to lesson in minutes
cons: Slide-based format may not suit all teaching styles
Less customizable than building from scratch

tools.name: Disco AI
tools.tagline: The AI-first platform for learning communities
tools.description: Disco AI is a modern learning platform that combines community building with AI-powered curriculum generation. It can automatically create course content from existing materials (documents, videos, URLs), generate discussion prompts, and adapt learning paths. Popular with professional development programs and corporate training at universities.
values: Generates complete course structures from a topic description
Maps assessments back to learning objectives automatically
Collaborative — share and iterate with department colleagues

pricing.details: Custom enterprise pricing. Contact for education institution rates. Free trial available.

keyFeatures: AI curriculum generation from existing content
Integration with Zoom for live sessions

tools.name: Teachfloor
tools.tagline: The all-in-one platform for collaborative learning
tools.description: Teachfloor combines an LMS with collaborative learning features including peer review, group projects, live Zoom sessions, and AI-assisted content creation. It is designed for cohort-based learning programs where interaction between participants is as important as the content itself.
values: Cohort-based learning design — not just self-paced content
Built-in discussion, peer review, and group activity tools
AI assists with content structuring and activity design

pricing.details: Pro plan starts at $99/mo. Business and Enterprise plans available with additional features.

cons: Smaller user community than major LMS

tools.name: Gradescope
tools.tagline: AI-assisted grading that saves hours every week
tools.description: Gradescope uses AI to streamline grading of exams, homework, and projects. Instructors create rubrics, and the AI groups similar answers together so you can grade by question across the entire class. It supports handwritten work via OCR, code autograding, and detailed analytics on student performance patterns.
values: AI groups similar answers — grade once, apply to all matches
Rubric-based grading ensures consistency across sections and TAs
Handles handwritten work, code, and STEM notation

pricing.details: Free basic tier for individual instructors. Institutional licensing through Turnitin (parent company) for full features including LMS integration.

keyFeatures: AI-assisted answer grouping for batch grading
pros: Works with handwritten and typed submissions
Strong analytics for identifying struggling students
cons: OCR can struggle with messy handwriting
strengths: Dramatically reduces grading time for large classes
AI grouping catches patterns humans miss
limitations: Institutional license required — can't self-serve easily
Learning curve for initial rubric setup
Best for structured assessments, less useful for open-ended projects
tools.quickstart: Start by uploading a past exam. Create your rubric, then use AI-assisted grouping to batch-grade similar responses.

tools.name: Turnitin
tools.tagline: Academic integrity and AI writing detection platform
tools.description: Turnitin is the industry-standard platform for plagiarism detection, now with AI writing detection capabilities. It identifies text likely generated by AI tools and provides similarity reports against a massive database of academic papers, websites, and student submissions. The Feedback Studio includes inline commenting and QuickMark rubrics.
values: Industry-standard AI writing detection with confidence scores
Similarity reports cross-reference billions of sources
Feedback Studio enables inline comments and rubric scoring

pricing.details: Institutional licensing only. Contact for pricing. Typically bundled with Gradescope and iThenticate.

pros: Industry standard — widely trusted by institutions
AI detection improving with each update
Integrates with all major LMS platforms
cons: AI detection has false positive concerns
Students find it punitive rather than educational

tools.name: Formative
tools.tagline: Real-time formative assessment with instant AI feedback
tools.description: Formative provides real-time formative assessment with AI-powered feedback, live student monitoring, and data-driven instructional insights. Teachers can see student responses as they work, and AI provides instant feedback so students don't have to wait for grading.
values: See student responses in real-time as they work
AI provides instant feedback so students don't wait for grading
Data dashboard reveals class-wide understanding gaps

pricing.details: Free for basic use. Premium for AI features and advanced analytics.

tools.name: Consensus
tools.tagline: AI-powered search engine for peer-reviewed research
tools.description: Consensus searches through over 200 million peer-reviewed papers to find and synthesize answers to research questions. It uses AI to extract key findings and present them with links to the original papers. The Consensus Meter shows the balance of evidence for or against a claim, making it a powerful tool for evidence-based decision-making.
values: Only searches peer-reviewed papers — no blog posts or SEO content
Synthesizes findings across multiple studies into a summary
Great teaching tool for modeling proper research methodology

pricing.details: Free tier with limited searches. Premium $6.99/mo with unlimited searches, GPT-4 summaries, and bookmarks.

keyFeatures: Paper summaries and key findings extraction
cons: Limited to indexed papers (not all journals)

tools.name: Elicit
tools.tagline: Automate your literature review with AI research assistance
tools.description: Elicit helps researchers find relevant papers, extract key data points, and synthesize findings across multiple studies. It goes beyond simple search by letting you define columns of information to extract from each paper (methods, sample size, findings, etc.) and building structured comparison tables automatically.
values: Extracts key findings, methods, and sample sizes from papers automatically
Builds structured evidence tables from search results
Saves hours of manual literature review work

pricing.details: Free tier with limited paper analysis. Plus $10/mo. Enterprise pricing for institutions.

pros: Structured data extraction is a game-changer
cons: Learning curve to set up extraction columns
Better for quantitative than qualitative research
bestFor: Faculty tenure and promotion evidence gathering

tools.name: Grammarly
tools.tagline: AI writing assistant with institution-wide analytics
tools.description: Grammarly goes beyond spell-check to provide AI-powered writing suggestions for clarity, tone, engagement, and delivery. The EDU plan adds plagiarism detection, citation support, organization-wide analytics, and FERPA-compliant data handling. It works across all browsers, email clients, and writing apps.
values: Tone detection helps match academic register expectations
Works in email, LMS, Google Docs — catches errors everywhere
Explains grammar rules — doubles as a learning tool

pricing.details: Free basic plan. Premium $12/mo individual. Grammarly for Education with institutional pricing and admin controls.

keyFeatures: Custom style guides for your institution
cons: Premium features needed for full value
May create dependency rather than learning

tools.name: Gamma
tools.tagline: A new medium for presenting ideas, powered by AI
tools.description: Gamma generates polished presentations, documents, and web pages from simple text prompts or existing content. Unlike traditional slide tools, Gamma creates interactive card-based layouts that work beautifully on any device. It supports embedding videos, charts, and interactive elements directly into the presentation.
values: Creates a full slide deck from a text description in minutes
Designs look professional — not the typical AI-generated aesthetic
Exports to PowerPoint for final editing in familiar tools

pricing.details: Free tier with Gamma branding. Plus $10/mo. Pro $20/mo with unlimited AI and custom branding.

keyFeatures: Embed videos, charts, and web content
pros: Much faster than building in PowerPoint
Card-based design looks modern and professional
cons: Less design control than traditional tools
Export to PowerPoint can lose formatting

tools.name: Mentimeter
tools.tagline: Make your audience feel heard with interactive presentations
tools.description: Mentimeter turns passive lectures into interactive experiences with live polls, quizzes, Q&A sessions, and word clouds that students participate in from their phones. The AI Menti Builder can generate entire interactive presentations from a topic description, including engagement activities and assessment questions.
values: Students respond from their phones — no app download needed
Live word clouds and polls make large lectures interactive
Quiz mode adds gamification without needing a separate tool

pricing.details: Free tier with limited questions per presentation. Pro $12/mo. Enterprise/Education pricing available.

keyFeatures: Live polls, quizzes, and word clouds
AI Menti Builder for presentation generation
pros: Works on any device — no app install needed
AI builder saves significant prep time
cons: Free tier very limited (2 question slides)
Requires reliable internet for all students

tools.name: Slidesgo
tools.tagline: Stunning presentation templates with AI generation
tools.description: Slidesgo offers thousands of professionally designed presentation templates for Google Slides and PowerPoint, plus an AI presentation maker that generates complete slide decks from a text prompt. Templates span education themes, infographics, thesis presentations, and more. Part of the Freepik ecosystem.
values: Thousands of education-specific templates available free
AI generates slide content from topic descriptions
Works natively with Google Slides — no new platform to learn

cons: AI generator less sophisticated than Gamma

tools.name: Canva
tools.tagline: AI-enhanced design platform for everyone
tools.description: Canva democratizes design with drag-and-drop tools now supercharged with AI features including Magic Write for text generation, Magic Design for instant layouts, Background Remover, and text-to-image generation. Canva for Education is completely free for K-12 and higher ed institutions, making it the most accessible design tool available.
values: Canva for Education is free for verified educators
Magic Design AI creates layouts from your content automatically
One platform for slides, posters, social media, and video

pros: FREE for Education — best value in the market
cons: Design quality ceiling lower than Adobe

tools.name: Midjourney
tools.tagline: Advancing creativity with high-quality AI image generation
tools.description: Midjourney produces the highest-quality AI-generated images available, with a distinctive aesthetic that leans photorealistic or painterly depending on prompts. Accessed through Discord or a new web editor, it excels at creating visual aids, conceptual illustrations, and educational graphics that would otherwise require a professional designer.
values: Highest aesthetic quality of any AI image generator
Great for custom course illustrations and visual metaphors

tools.name: Synthesia

Ideal for creating training videos, lecture supplements, course introductions, and multilingual content. The platform offers 230+ diverse avatars or custom avatar creation.

160+ AI avatars and 130+ languages for global accessibility

tools.name: RunwayML
tools.tagline: The next frontier of AI-powered video creation
tools.description: RunwayML offers a comprehensive suite of AI video tools including Gen-3 Alpha for text-to-video, image-to-video transformation, motion brush for animating still images, and advanced video editing features. values: Generate short video clips from text descriptions
Remove backgrounds, extend scenes, and edit with AI tools
Strong for creating visual content for online courses

keyFeatures: Green screen without a green screen
pros: Most advanced AI video generation available
Rapid improvement with each model version

Steep learning curve for advanced features
bestFor: Creating visual explanations for complex topics

tools.name: Pika Labs

cons: Processing can be slow for long recordings

tools.name: HeyGen
tools.tagline: AI video generation with customizable avatars

Choose from 100+ stock avatars or create a custom avatar from a short video of yourself. Particularly popular for training videos, course content, and social media where consistent, professional video is needed at scale.
values: Clone your own likeness for consistent video presence

tools.name: Fliki

tools.name: Sora

Create realistic scenario videos for case studies and simulations

tools.name: Ideogram

tools.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
